title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with all required valid CFDI profile information.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Input valid user credentials and all required CFDI profile fields.
Submit the registration form.
Check that the registration is successful and user is redirected or logged in.

title: User Registration with Missing Required Fields
description: Ensure the registration form validation prevents submission when required fields are missing.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Input incomplete user data, missing mandatory CFDI profile fields.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
Verify appropriate validation messages prevent form submission.

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that a user with valid credentials can log in successfully and receive a JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Click the login button.
Ensure login is successful, JWT token is issued and user is directed to dashboard.

title: User Login with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify login fails with invalid credentials and proper error is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input incorrect username/email and password.
Attempt to submit the login form.
Login fails and error message is displayed.

title: Profile Management CRUD Operations
description: Validate that authenticated users can retrieve, update, and delete their CFDI profile data.

steps.description: Log in with a valid user account.
Fetch current profile data via API or UI.
Current profile data is presented correctly.
Update profile fields with valid new data.
Changes are saved and reflected immediately.
Delete profile or specific profile data if supported.
Deletion operation completes successfully and data is removed.

title: Task Creation with Valid Natural Language Prompt
description: Ensure that users can create browser automation tasks successfully by submitting natural language CFDI task requests.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to task submission interface.
Enter a valid natural language prompt describing the CFDI task.
Submit the task creation request.
Task is created with correct parameters and appears in the monitoring dashboard.

title: Task Creation with Invalid or Empty Input
description: Verify the system prevents submission of automation tasks when the input prompt is invalid or empty.

steps.description: Navigate to task submission page.
Input an empty or syntactically invalid natural language prompt.
Attempt to submit task creation form.
Submission is rejected with meaningful validation error.

title: OCR Processing Accuracy for Major Vendor
description: Verify that the OCR engine extracts all expected CFDI fields with high confidence from tickets for a major Mexican retailer using vendor-specific templates.

steps.description: Upload a sample ticket image for a major vendor.
Trigger OCR processing using both Azure Document Intelligence and LangExtract engines.
OCR output contains correctly extracted CFDI fields matching expected schema with confidence thresholds met.

title: OCR Processing with Unsupported Vendor
description: Ensure system handles OCR requests for tickets from unsupported or unknown vendors gracefully with appropriate error or fallback.

steps.description: Upload a ticket image from an unsupported vendor.
Submit OCR processing request.
System returns an error or fallback response indicating unsupported vendor without crashing.

title: Create and Execute Browser Agent Task
description: Verify the lifecycle of a browser automation task from creation, execution, real-time status updates, to completion.

steps.description: Create a new browser agent task via the API or dashboard.
Start execution of the browser automation task.
Task status updates are streamed in real-time via WebSocket and reflected on UI.
Wait for task completion.
Task completes successfully with expected logs and output.

title: Pause, Resume and Cancel Browser Agent Task
description: Validate that users can pause, resume, and cancel running browser automation tasks and receive correct status updates.

steps.description: Start a browser agent task execution.
Send pause command to the running task.
Task status changes to paused and logs reflect the pause action.
Resume the paused task.
Task status updates to running and continues execution.
Cancel the running task.
Task terminates and status changes to canceled with proper logs.

title: WebSocket Real-Time Status Handling
description: Confirm that WebSocket connection streams live updates for task status, logs, and browser agent control commands correctly and resiliently.

steps.description: Connect to WebSocket endpoint during task execution.
Receive continuous real-time updates about task status and logs.
Send control commands (pause/resume/takeover) via WebSocket.
Commands are executed and corresponding status changes received.

title: API Endpoint Contract Compliance
description: Verify that all RESTful API endpoints (authentication, tasks, OCR, browser control, health checks) conform to documented request and response schemas including error cases.

steps.description: Send correctly formatted requests to each API endpoint.
Responses meet expected status codes and data schemas.
Send malformed or unauthorized requests.
API returns appropriate error codes and messages without leaking sensitive information.

title: Frontend Components Render without Hydration Mismatches
description: Ensure that React/Next.js frontend components render correctly without hydration or reconciliation errors in various browsers and devices.

steps.description: Load main frontend pages (login, dashboard, task submission, monitoring) in supported browsers.
No hydration mismatch warnings or UI glitches occur during server-side rendering and client hydration.
Resize browser and test responsive layouts.
UI adjusts correctly and remains stable.

title: Docker Container Build and Health Check Validation
description: Verify that all containerized services (frontend, backend, browser service, nginx, redis) build, start successfully, and pass health checks.

steps.description: Execute docker-compose build and bring up all services.
All containers start without errors and remain running.
Send requests to health endpoints of each service.
Health endpoints respond with success and expected status.

title: Error Logging and Graceful Failure Handling
description: Verify that system logs errors clearly and handles failure scenarios gracefully for API failures, OCR errors, and browser automation exceptions without data loss.

steps.description: Simulate errors such as invalid OCR input, API unauthorized access, and browser agent crashes.
System logs error details with timestamps and context.
User-facing error messages are informative and no data corruption occurs.

title: Rate Limiting and Authorization Enforcement
description: Confirm that the system enforces JWT authorization correctly and rate limits sensitive endpoints to prevent abuse.

steps.description: Attempt to access protected API endpoints without JWT or with invalid tokens.
Access is denied with proper HTTP 401/403 responses.
Send large volume of requests exceeding rate limit thresholds.
System enforces rate limiting and responds with HTTP 429 errors accordingly.

title: Vendor-Specific OCR Template Switching
description: Test that the OCR processing engine correctly detects vendor from ticket input and applies the corresponding extraction template and scoring.

steps.description: Upload ticket images from multiple supported vendors.
System detects vendor correctly for each input.
Appropriate OCR extraction template and confidence scoring is applied for each vendor.

title: Frontend Task Monitoring Display Accuracy
description: Ensure the dashboard interface accurately displays task status, statistics, and log information with real-time updates.

steps.description: Create and execute sample tasks to generate monitoring data.
Navigate to the dashboard monitoring view.
Task statuses and statistics appear correct and reflect real-time data from backend.
Logs and updates refresh dynamically without UI glitches.

title: Comprehensive Automated Test Suite Execution
description: Run all existing automated unit, integration, API, and end-to-end tests to verify test coverage and passing status.

steps.description: Execute backend API and integration tests.
All backend tests pass without failures.
Run frontend component unit and UI tests.
Frontend tests pass with coverage meeting target thresholds.
Run end-to-end user flow tests covering registration, login, task lifecycle, and OCR processing.
All e2e tests complete successfully.
